prompt: A kreetle (Kreetle), a Star Wars canon creature. Kreetle were a fast breeding arthropod native to the planet Tatooine. They were was often found in cities, homes, and other urban areas and were universally considered a pest. They gave birth to young in the form of maggot-like larvae. Kreetles thrived on dead creatures, garbage and vegetable remains (including waste).
